sections.h2: VAT, ZATCA Invoices and PDPL Consent
sections.intro: Saudi websites must handle a few legal details correctly:

items.html: 15% VAT display: prices shown clearly as VAT-inclusive, with VAT on invoices.

ZATCA e-invoicing: we set up a website with ZATCA compliant invoices by connecting your store to e-invoicing software or an approved solution that meets ZATCA's Fatoora requirements. See the official ZATCA website for current phases.
PDPL consent: Saudi Arabia's Personal Data Protection Law requires clear consent before tracking. We add a consent banner, a plain privacy notice and forms that ask only for what you need.

outro.text: We are not tax or legal advisers, so your accountant should confirm your VAT and e-invoicing setup. This is how we deliver bilingual, VAT-ready websites for KSA companies.
